metadata.question: Did an island appear in the Caspian Sea within 4 km of coordinates 39.014501, 49.357405 on February 13, 2023, but did not exist on November 19, 2022?

data.raw_code: The user asks: "Did an island appear in the Caspian Sea within 4 km of coordinates 39.014501, 49.357405 on February 13, 2023, but did not exist on November 19, 2022?" Interpretation: We need to detect land presence in a 4 km radius around the given point on two specific dates. The island should be present on 2023-02-13 but absent on 2022-11-19. Strategy: 1. Define a 4 km buffer around the point (39.014501, 49.357405). 2. Use Sentinel-2 surface reflectance (10m resolution) to detect land vs water. 3. For each date: a. Get a cloud-masked image (using SCL band) closest to the target date within a 5-day window. b. Classify land using SCL classes 4 (vegetation) and 5 (bare ground). c. Count valid (cloud-free) pixels and land pixels within the buffer. 4. If no Sentinel-2 image exists, try Landsat 8/9 as fallback. 5. Compare land counts: - If 2022-11-19 has 0 land pixels AND 2023-02-13 has >0 land pixels → Answer A (Yes). - Otherwise → Answer B (No). 6. Handle edge cases: - No images for either date → C1. - No valid pixels after cloud masking → C2. - Invalid calculations (NaN, null) → C3. Data considerations: - Use Sentinel-2 L2A (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED) for better cloud masking via SCL band. - Use a 5-day window (±2 days) to account for missing acquisitions. - Scale=20m for reduceRegion (SCL band resolution). ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry and parameters const point = ee.Geometry.Point([49.357405, 39.014501]); const buffer = point.buffer(4000); // 4 km buffer const scale = 20; // SCL band resolution in meters // Date ranges: ±2 days around target dates const date1Start = '2022-11-17'; const date1End = '2022-11-21'; const date2Start = '2023-02-11'; const date2End = '2023-02-17'; // 2. Function to get least cloudy Sentinel-2 image in date range function getS2Image(startDate, endDate, geometry) { const col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)) .sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE'); return col.first(); } // 3. Function to count land and valid pixels function countLandPixels(image, geometry) { if (!image || !image.bandNames().size().getInfo()) { return { valid: 0, land: 0, hasImage: false }; } const scl = image.select('SCL'); // Land classes: 4 (vegetation), 5 (bare ground) const landMask = scl.eq(4).or(scl.eq(5)); // Valid pixels: not cloud, shadow, cirrus, no-data, defective const validMask = scl.neq(0) .and(scl.neq(1)) .and(scl.neq(3)) .and(scl.neq(8)) .and(scl.neq(9)) .and(scl.neq(10)); const validCount = validMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, }).get('SCL'); const landCount = landMask.updateMask(validMask).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, }).get('SCL'); return { valid: validCount.getInfo(), land: landCount.getInfo(), hasImage: true }; } // 4. Get and process images for both dates let img1 = getS2Image(date1Start, date1End, buffer); let img2 = getS2Image(date2Start, date2End, buffer); // Check if images exist const size1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(buffer).filterDate(date1Start, date1End).size().getInfo(); const size2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(buffer).filterDate(date2Start, date2End).size().getInfo(); console.log(`2022-11-19 window: ${size1} images`); console.log(`2023-02-13 window: ${size2} images`); // Fallback to Landsat if no Sentinel-2 images (C1 early detection) if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log('C1: Empty Collection (no images for one/both dates)'); console.log('C1'); return; } const result1 = countLandPixels(img1, buffer); const result2 = countLandPixels(img2, buffer); console.log(`2022-11-19: Valid pixels=${result1.valid}, Land pixels=${result1.land}`); console.log(`2023-02-13: Valid pixels=${result2.valid}, Land pixels=${result2.land}`); // 5. Validate results // Case C2: No valid pixels after masking if (result1.valid === 0 || result2.valid === 0) { console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels after cloud masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Case C3: Invalid calculations if (result1.land === null || result2.land === null || isNaN(result1.land) || isNaN(result2.land)) { console.log('C3: Calculation Failure (null/NaN)'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 6. Determine final answer const islandAppeared = (result1.land === 0 && result2.land > 0); if (islandAppeared) { console.log('A: Yes (island present in 2023, absent in 2022)'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B: No (island did not appear as described)'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```

2023-02-13 window: 1 images

<answer>C1</answer>
